short: Shell backing just recipes and hooks
is: Shell scripts backing the `just` dev-loop recipes and jj/session hooks — not cargo tests, but scripted proofs and glue for the manual dev loop.
conventions: `ZURFUR_*` env convention (env wins over `.env.example` defaults); each smoke script proves the dev loop itself at the shell/`just` level, distinct from the automated per-test-throwaway integration harness.
entry_points: ../Justfile (the pds-provision, pds-smoke, web-smoke, den-fill, workspace-init, nodes-install recipes call these)

fs.name: build-id.sh
fs.role: prints one line for ZURFUR_BUILD_ID: jj's working-copy parent commit (12 chars), else git HEAD, plus " (local changes)" when the working copy differs, else "unknown"; quiet, never fails, at most 64 bytes; the dev recipes export it when unset (tested by build-id.test.sh)

fs.name: cargo-config-check.sh
fs.role: fails on any tracked path with a .cargo segment (a file or folder under .cargo, or a .cargo symlink cargo would follow), at any depth and in any letter case (a cargo config could set a rustc-wrapper, linker or runner and run its own code in any cargo call); lists with jj file list, else git ls-files; exits 1 listing each path, 2 on a failed or empty listing (just cargo-config-check, in just gate and CI's hooks job; tested by cargo-config-check.test.sh)

fs.name: cargo-config-check.test.sh
fs.role: tests for cargo-config-check.sh against scratch git repos with a stub jj that always fails: each config path and case caught, any other path under .cargo and a .cargo symlink (at the root and in backend/) caught, lookalikes and untracked files pass, an empty listing exits 2, today's tree passes

fs.name: ci-changes.sh
fs.role: the body of CI's changes job: verifies a PR's merge parents or a merge group's head and base, diffs, classifies with the base's ci-paths.sh (a merge group always runs everything) and passes on its code, lock and npmlock; fails closed

fs.name: ci-paths.sh
fs.role: classifies changed paths for CI's changes job (code: anything but docs-only; lock: a Cargo.lock; npmlock: an npm lockfile, a root osv-scanner.*.toml or the root npm-licences.json) and, with --paths, for just gate-light; fails closed

fs.name: compose-logs.sh
fs.role: follows each compose service (db, plc, pds, caddy) from just before `just up` into logs/compose/<service>/: one setsid follower per service with a pidfile, the old one stopped first (only if its pid and start time still match), stopped by `just down` (tested by compose-logs.test.sh against a stub docker)

fs.name: den-fill.sh
fs.role: fills your Den on just dev with two commissions, one archived, as you, through the commission routes (one read-only SELECT for the skeleton tab id); the session cookie reaches curl only on stdin, and ZURFUR_PUBLIC_URL, checked to be a bare origin before the cookie is read, goes as every call's Origin header in an argument (just den-fill; tested by den-fill.test.sh and api/tests/den_postgres.rs)

fs.name: dev-log.sh
fs.role: the wrapper every dev recipe runs through: the terminal keeps its bytes, logs/<name>/<UTC stamp>.log gets them as plain text (a pipe through tee and a SIGINT-proof stripper, never script(1)), logs/latest/<name>.log links the newest, 10 kept, 0600 (tested by dev-log.test.sh)

fs.name: gate-light.sh
fs.role: the light local gate for base merges and fix rounds (just gate-light): fmt, clippy, typos, the design-index and node-tree checks, the touched crates' tests, and, on a frontend/ or contract/ change, the guarded frontend install, the install guard's tests and web's and ui's checks, the built-output check included (tested by gate-light.test.sh)

fs.name: hooks/
fs.role: the SessionStart/PreToolUse hook scripts wired in .claude/settings.json, and their tests

fs.name: jj-push.sh
fs.role: pre-push gate for jj — fmt + lint before code leaves the machine

fs.name: log-files.sh
fs.role: sourced by dev-log.sh, compose-logs.sh and logs.sh: the logs/ root (ZURFUR_LOG_DIR overrides), marked with .zurfur-logs only when missing or empty (a populated unmarked root is refused and left untouched), a fresh stamped file per run, the latest link (mv -fT) and the keep-10 retention

fs.name: logs.sh
fs.role: behind `just logs-tail [name]` (tail -F the latest files; an unknown name lists the names) and `just logs-clean` (stops the followers, removes logs/, only a root carrying the .zurfur-logs marker) (tested by logs.test.sh)

fs.name: nodes-0-7-edits.sh
fs.role: TEMPORARY: the node-text edits of the move to nodes 0.7, as idempotent get → set transforms; `--check` lists any not applied; a branch cut before the migration replays it when it catches up (tested by nodes-0-7-edits.test.sh)

fs.name: nodes-fmt-hook.sh
fs.role: PostToolUse hook — nodes fmt on any NODE.inf.json or NODE.refs.json a model writes, in that file's own tree; silent on a tree from before nodes 0.7, refuses a NODE.json in a current one; fails soft without the binary or with one older than 0.7 (tested by nodes-fmt-hook.test.sh)

fs.name: nodes-install.sh
fs.role: download the pinned nodes release binary (checksum-verified) into ~/.cargo/bin; cargo-install fallback

fs.name: nodes-tree-check.sh
fs.role: the tree guards `just nodes-check` runs after `nodes check`: no NODE.json outside hidden and build folders, a node tree here, every NODE.inf.json and NODE.refs.json tracked; fails closed (tested by nodes-tree-check.test.sh)

fs.name: npm-advisories.sh
fs.role: scans frontend/yarn.lock and lexicons/package-lock.json with the pinned osv-scanner (Linux x86_64, checked by SHA-256 on every run, cached under ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/zurfur-tools) under a clean environment, each with its own root ignore file held to an allow-list (only IgnoredVulns entries of id, reason and an ignoreUntil at most 90 days out) before any download or scan (--allow-list-only stops there); a self-test on cookie 0.6.0 and a package-count check prove the scanner checked; exits 0 clean, 1 an advisory, 2 a broken ignore file, 3 couldn't check, 4 a hash mismatch; NPM_ADVISORIES_MODE=report demotes 1 and 3 to a warning (just npm-advisories, last in just gate; the daily advisories workflow)

fs.name: npm-advisories.test.sh
fs.role: tests for npm-advisories.sh against a stub curl and a stub scanner, offline: the allow-list before any download, --allow-list-only, bad binaries, the self-test and count check, exit codes and modes, per-lockfile configs and the scanner's clean environment

fs.name: npm-lock-ci.sh
fs.role: the body of CI's npm-lock job, normally the PR base's copy: verifies the base, takes the advisory script, lock-review.mjs, install-check.mjs and licences.mjs as one set from the base (HEAD's, only when the base lacks this driver, with a warning), the licence list npm-licences.json from the same source (a base with the driver but no list exits 1), the old lockfiles and lock-age-waivers.json from the base, and each lockfile's osv-scanner ignores from the base when that lockfile changed; reads each base path only as a regular file (mode 100644) under plain folders, or exits 1 naming it and its mode, and finds (exit 1) any path of that read set (the driver, the tools, the data) that is neither absent nor a regular file under plain folders at HEAD; runs the advisory scan (block or report) and the 7-day floor and licence rule over both lockfiles under env -i, then checks the change's own files it didn't use (its ignore files through the allow-list when a base's was scanned, HEAD's waivers parsed by lock-review when they differ from the base's, and, when HEAD's licence list differs from the base's or is deleted, a sweep of every entry of both lockfiles against it by the base's lock-review, always blocking; both lists read from HEAD's blobs, never the working tree), every check even after one fails, and exits with the worst code

fs.name: npm-lock-ci.test.sh
fs.role: tests for npm-lock-ci.sh and the npm-lock job's inline step (extracted from ci.yml and run as GitHub runs it) against scratch git repos with real test merges, stub tools and a stub node: which copy runs, base verification (the step's, before it falls back to the change's driver, and the driver's), the waivers', licence list's, ignores' and old lockfiles' sources, the checks of the change's own waivers, ignore files and licence list (the sweep) read from HEAD rather than the working tree, regular files only (a symlinked, executable or symlinked-folder path at HEAD is a finding; a symlinked list, waivers, tool or driver, or a symlinked scripts folder, at the base exits 1 and runs nothing), the clean environments and the worst exit code

fs.name: npm-lock-pins.test.sh
fs.role: pins the npm-lock job's three steps, setup-node's package cache switched off (and no other cache key), its inline step's lines (the base's driver only as a regular file, its scripts folder only as a folder), its mode expression, the web, ui and contract jobs waiting on it, the driver's tools, read set and regular-file checks at the base and at HEAD, env -i, 7-day floor, the base's licence list for every floor and the waivers parse, and checks of the change's own waivers, ignore files and licence list (read from HEAD), the daily npm-advisories and npm-licences jobs, the guard's node --test line (licences.test.mjs included) in just gate, gate-light and CI's ui job, just npm-lock-review's licence list, just cargo-config-check in just gate and CI's hooks job, and just gate ending on just npm-licences then just npm-advisories

fs.name: pds-provision.sh
fs.role: create/sign into the fixture test account on the local dev PDS, print session JSON

fs.name: pds-smoke-test.sh
fs.role: shell-level scripted proof the local PDS+PLC dev loop boots and is repeatable

fs.name: pr-wait.sh
fs.role: waits once for a PR's CI and Copilot review, then prints a short verdict

fs.name: tools-check.sh
fs.role: local tool versions vs CI's pins (warns), and the workflow checks (fails): every uses: a step's (no job-level uses:, a reusable workflow call) naming one of the seven actions on its allow list at the one commit SHA reviewed for it (a bump changes the workflow and the table together); no quoted mapping key, no explicit (?) key and no tag, anchor or alias where a key starts outside run:/shell: script text and ${{ }} expressions, and no line break awk does not split on (a lone CR, NEL, LS or PS) anywhere; tool versions equal to the Justfile's, and the CI safety rules (read-only top-level permissions, no job-level permissions, persist-credentials: false on every checkout, no pull_request_target or secrets, every yarn install exactly frontend/install-check.mjs's INSTALL_COMMAND and wrapped in the install guard's steps, and no other package manager (npm, npx, pnpm, pnpx, bun, bunx, corepack), no yarn --use-yarnrc and no yarn create, policies, set, init, config or workspace in any run: or shell:); just tools-check, and --pins-only in CI's hooks job (tested by tools-check.test.sh)

fs.name: web-smoke.sh
fs.role: shell-level scripted proof the one-origin Caddy routing split works

fs.name: workspace-init.sh
fs.role: gives a secondary jj workspace (or a git worktree) its own dev-loop ports, DB and compose project through a managed .env block; refuses the primary checkout (just workspace-init; tested by workspace-init.test.sh)

notes: jj-push.sh (the `jj push` alias) runs as a hook, not just a recipe; the Claude Code hooks live in hooks/.
